name: qfd_slab_pair_add-pa1-COMMIT
purpose: port_tiles pair-adder leaf (x4 per word half, 24 per die band set)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_slab_pair_add u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_slab_pair_add.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pair_add/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pair_add/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pair_add --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_slab_pair_add  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: q15 port-tiles: new leaf. The four level-6->7 FP32 pair adders of each slab word half (ck_pair0-3, 9,778 sinks each) were inline in qfd_slab_word_half and shared the 2.46 mm port_tiles parent; each is now its own hardened tile on its own die clock entry (structure-only, hierarchy-equivalence bench fc0e16f69).
